Author: Local
Name: DualSense Lighting
Description: Custom USB DualSense lighting with a live preview. RGB effects include two-color blends, aurora, fire, heartbeat, comet and pulsing rainbow, alongside independent white player-indicator animations. Custom lights turn off and controller handles close automatically when FFXIV loses focus, so other lighting apps can take over. Background game lighting is always guarded. Native haptics, speaker and triggers pass through.
Punchline: Custom DualSense lighting with protection for other apps.
